githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.5 Beta 2 fixes update labeling and makes moving between Nightly and Regular release tracks clearer.

## Update labels

- Fixed Sparkle prompts so nightly updates show full beta names such as `0.1.5 Beta 2`.

## Release tracks

- Changed Nightly-to-Regular switching to offer the latest Regular release directly instead of reporting the newer Nightly build as up to date.
- Added clear guidance when installing the Regular release requires a manual replacement because Sparkle blocks downgrades.

## Release announcements

- Removed duplicate moon emoji from generated nightly announcement titles so the emoji appears only in the main headline.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.5-Beta-1...v0.1.5-Beta-2](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.5-Beta-1...v0.1.5-Beta-2)
discordAnnouncement:
**Clearer beta updates and release-track switching 🌙**

**Highlights**
- Nightly updates now show full beta labels in Sparkle
- Switching from Nightly to Regular no longer shows a misleading up-to-date message
- A new Get Regular Release action makes moving back to Regular straightforward
- Nightly announcements now keep the moon only in the main headline
